hook: Your favorite streaming apps could vanish after the massive $110.9 billion merger.

sections.voiceover: Your favorite streaming apps could vanish after the massive $110.9 billion merger.
On October 19, 2026, five subscribers filed a legal motion in the United States District Court for the Northern District of California. Will these services stay independent?
But the motion demands Skydance Corporation keep Paramount+ and HBO Max operating as separate services.

Judge Araceli Martínez-Olguín will oversee the preliminary injunction hearing regarding this case. The hearing at 1301 Clay Street decides if Skydance Corporation must preserve these independent services.
The $110.9 billion deal remains under intense judicial scrutiny today.
